verdict.rationale: The only programmatic channel in evidence is CRA's own EFILE service, where certified tax software run by enrolled electronic filers transmits returns system-to-system (cra-docs-14, cra-docs-19, cra-supp-3). It is gated behind a vendor certification process and filer enrollment, and covers only return filing. Every other e-service described is a human-facing portal (cra-docs-8, cra-docs-9, cra-docs-1), and the probe found no llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs index (cra-probe-2). Missing for 10: an openly accessible public API, published API reference or specification, coverage beyond return transmission (registration, payments, account queries), agent-oriented documentation, and independent corroboration.
